name: dfreds-droppables
description: A FoundryVTT module which allows you to drag and drop an entire folder of tokens or journal entries onto the canvas, upload files for tokens, tiles, sounds, or notes, and drop files directly onto sidebar directories to instantly create the matching documents.

scripts.stage: npm run clean && vite build --mode stage
scripts.dev: npm run clean && vite build --mode development
scripts.watch: npm run clean && vite build --watch --mode development
scripts.lint: npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:json && npm run prettier:scss

author: DFreds (https://github.com/DFreds)
